# CHRON — Temporal Intelligence & Calibration Engine
> "Demi masa. Time is the witness."
> The temporal cortex of the arifOS Federation.
> Port: 18102 (FastMCP streamable-http) | Authority: 555_COMPUTE_ONLY | License: AGPL-3.0
> Public Endpoint: https://chron.arif-fazil.com/mcp | Local Service: chron-mcp.service

## Identity & Purpose
CHRON is not a cron scheduler, not a calendar, and not a passive database.
It is the **temporal cortex** of the arifOS Federation, enforcing the Arrow of Time:
$$\text{Event} \longrightarrow \text{Prediction} \longrightarrow \text{Verification} \longrightarrow \text{Error/Gap} \longrightarrow \text{Lesson} \longrightarrow \text{Policy}$$

Its primary mission is **Calibration Verification**:
- Every belief about the future must be falsifiable and dated.
- Predictions are scored with proper scoring rules (Brier score, ECE calibration).
- The gap between expectation and reality is the sole genuine training fuel for wisdom.
- CHRON computes and verifies. It never adjudicates (arifOS judges) and never executes mutations (A-FORGE acts).

## MCP Tools (19 Tools)

### Prediction & Verification
- `chron_active_predictions`: Query forward-looking predictions currently open in the state store.
- `chron_predictions_due`: Surface predictions that have reached their target resolution timestamp.
- `chron_record_verification`: Record the ground-truth observed outcome for a due prediction (`VERIFIED_TRUE`, `VERIFIED_FALSE`, `UNVERIFIABLE`).
- `chron_verified_predictions`: Historical audit ledger of all closed predictions and verification receipts.
- `chron_generate_predictions`: Generate structured, falsifiable predictions from new incoming events.
- `chron_resolve_unverifiable`: Prune or resolve predictions that cannot be tested against reality.

### Calibration & Learning
- `chron_calibration_state`: Compute Brier score, calibration curve, and overconfidence/underconfidence curves across prediction domains.
- `chron_lessons`: Retrieve accumulated lessons learned from historical prediction gaps.
- `chron_episodes`: Query multi-step narrative episodes and learning state.

### Temporal Events & Attention Debt
- `chron_create_event`: Register a new timestamped event anchor in the temporal state store.
- `chron_active_events`: List currently active events under observation.
- `chron_temporal_briefing`: Generate executive synthesis of temporal status, overdue checks, and temporal drift.
- `chron_attention_debt`: Calculate accumulated attention debt from open loops, expired horizons, and unclosed predictions.
- `chron_reconcile_state`: Reconcile state horizons between fast loops and long-term milestones.

### Proxy vs Reality Framework
- `chron_proxy_reality_register`: Register paired proxy indicators against ground-truth reality metrics.
- `chron_proxy_reality_observe`: Ingest real-world observations for registered proxy/reality metric pairs.
- `chron_proxy_reality_state`: Evaluate statistical correlation and divergence between proxy metrics and reality.

### Diagnostics & Store Health
- `chron_store_stats`: Integrity statistics, record generation count, and schema version.
- `chron_last_loop`: Review telemetry and logs from the latest automated verification loop.

## Machine Integration
To connect any MCP-enabled agent (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity, Gemini CLI):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "chron": {
      "url": "https://chron.arif-fazil.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Or query health directly:
```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18102/health
```
